#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using i128 = __int128_t;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
const long long MODD = 1000000007;
const int MAX_LEN = 1000005;
const long long INF = 1000000000000000000LL;

long long pow10[15];
vector<string> candidates[7];
vector<int> processed[7][7];
long long prefix_sum[7][7];

inline long long str_to_ll(const string& s) {
    long long res = 0;
    for (char c : s) res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
    return res;
}

inline i128 compute(const string& prefix, int remaining, long long& counter) {
    if (remaining == -1) return 0;
    int left_len = remaining / 2;
    int right_len = remaining - left_len;
    if (remaining == 1) {
        left_len = 1;
        right_len = 0;
    }
    
    i128 result = (counter - str_to_ll(prefix) + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
    counter++;
    
    for (const string& left_part : candidates[left_len]) {
        string combined = prefix + left_part;
        result += (-str_to_ll(combined) + counter + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
        counter++;
        
        if ((int)left_part.size() == left_len) {
            long long val = str_to_ll(combined) % MOD;
            for (int right_size = 1; right_size <= right_len; ++right_size) {
                long long constant = (-val * pow10[right_size] + counter + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
                auto& vec = processed[right_len][right_size];
                int idx = lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), MOD - constant) - vec.begin();
                result += (i128)vec.size() * constant + prefix_sum[right_len][right_size] - (i128)MOD * (vec.size() - idx);
            }
            counter += candidates[right_len].size();
        }
    }
    return result;
}

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    int total_digits = to_string(n).size();
    
    pow10[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) pow10[i] = pow10[i-1] * 10;
    
    string s = to_string(n);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LEN; ++i) {
        string num_str = to_string(i);
        string padded = num_str;
        while ((int)padded.size() <= 6) {
            padded = "0" + padded;
            candidates[(int)padded.size()].push_back(padded);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 1; len <= 6; ++len) {
        for (const string& prev : candidates[len-1]) {
            candidates[len].push_back(prev);
        }
        sort(candidates[len].begin(), candidates[len].end());

            processed[len][candidates[len][j].size()].push_back(val);
        }
        
        for (int sz = 1; sz <= len; ++sz) {
            sort(processed[len][sz].begin(), processed[len][sz].end());
            for (int v : processed[len][sz]) {
                prefix_sum[len][sz] += v;
            }
        }

    string current = "";
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.size(); ++i) {
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {

            if (i == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
            
            current += char('0' + digit);
            if (digit <= s[i] - '0') {
                queries.emplace_back(current, (int)s.size() - i - 1);
            } else {
                queries.emplace_back(current, (int)s.size() - i - 2);
            }
            current.pop_back();
        }
        current += s[i];
        queries.emplace_back(current, 0);
    }
    
    long long counter = 1;
    i128 answer = 0;
    sort(queries.begin(), queries.end());
    
    for (const auto& q : queries) {
        if (s[q.first.size() - 1] == q.first.back()) {
            answer += (-str_to_ll(q.first) + counter + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
            counter++;
            continue;
        }
        answer += compute(q.first, q.second, counter);
    }
    
    answer %= MODD;
    cout << (long long)answer << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
